title: Senior Account Manager
description:
🧡 About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt.

As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.

With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

 

👐 About the team

Our Account Manager team key role is to position Alma as a true business partner with our top merchants. In short, our Account Managers are in charge of a portfolio of large accounts, with whom you'll work closely to make them successful.

You'll be arriving at the beginning of the experience, as our team was created in March 2021. There is still a lot to create! This means you'll have a key role in shaping the function.

Reporting to the Account Manager Team Lead, you will work closely with the Sales team, the Onboarding team, the Retail Training team and the Merchant Support team.

This position is a permanent role, based in Paris. 

 

💼 About the job

In a nutshell, your key responsibilities will consist in:

  • Manage, negotiate and retain a portfolio of large accounts. Establish trustful relationships with Alma’s large merchants. Be the key point of communication for the merchants' stakeholders, while working closely with the other functions (Onboarding, Training, Support).
  • Deliver meaningful insights. Analyse merchants' performance to provide superior insights on their businesses. Develop expertise in your field to constantly position Alma as a strategic partner, helping the merchants achieve their goals.
  • Identify key business opportunities. Identify up-sell/cross-sell opportunities on your accounts and develop strategic plans with the merchants. Ensure your accounts get the most out of Alma (maximise conversion, increase turnover, increase basket size) by leveraging the tools we have developed.
  • Be the voice of merchants. Share insights and feedback from merchants with the Product & Engineering team and the wider organisation, helping to constantly improve our solution and the merchants' experience.

 

🧰 You will work with

  • Salesforce
  • Gong
  • Aircall
  • Dust
  • SalesNavigator

 

🧩 About you

To succeed in this job

  • You have ideally more than 5 years of relevant experiences (full-time permanent positions) in similar functions such as a Sales or an Account Manager / Shop manager in the Retail industry.
  • We are seeking individuals who demonstrate coachability and a strong willingness to learn and grow.
  • You’re fluent in French and a full professional proficiency in English are mandatory. 
  • Commercial skills: You like finding new opportunities for mutual gains. You are at ease in negotiation & closing discussions.
  • KPI Driven: You are comfortable and autonomous in managing your portfolio using identified key KPIs, you like talking numbers!

And it will be nice if you also

  • Demanding and reliable: You set high goals for yourself. You don't compromise on the quality of your work, and you always deliver on your commitments.
  • Empathetic: You easily get into other people's shoes. You are always keen to do the extra mile for clients to make them successful.
  • Autonomous and driven: You know how to find the solution to an issue and look for the information you need. You are comfortable obtaining information from the Alma teams who can help you obtain solutions quickly (product, finance, risk, sales etc...)
  • Great communicator: You have excellent written and oral communication skills. You know how to adapt to your audience.

 

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.

 

🧘 What's in it for you?

  • Join a growing company that's reshaping how merchants and consumers connect
  • High ownership from day one, with real impact on business growth
  • A fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where your ideas and results matter
  • The chance to help build a category and be part of something meaningful

 

🤑 Compensation & benefits

  • Competitive salary based on 12 months
  • Profit-sharing and employee savings plan
  • Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package
  • Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma
  • Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities
  • Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.
  • Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year (excluding full-remote contracts)
  • Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma
  • Mental health: free access to MindDay platform
  • Paid time off: 25 days/year ****(+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)
  • Access to our Learning & Development Platform
  • 2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer


🎯 Interview Process

  • Recruiter interview (30 min)
  • Remote Hiring Manager interview (45 min)
  • On-site/Remote Business Case Study presentation (60 min)
  • On-site Final interview with the VP Sales (45 min) + Team Fit (45 min)
  • Reference check

 

🌍 Interview Process

At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels seen, respected, and empowered to do their best work whatever their gender, background, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability or lived experience. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all walks of life, and all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

title: Director of Operations - UK
description:
Type: Full-time, salaried employment
Location: Remote in the UK only, with expected regular travel to retailer sites across the UK
Salary Range: £98,000 - £112,000 depending on experience + stock options

Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. We are headquartered in San Francisco, California with operations in Canada and the UK, and a tech-hub in Poland. We are a Deep Learning first company. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick and mortar retail using deep learning computer vision. Focal Systems has been deployed at scale with some of the top retailers in the world.

We seek smart, creative and passionate people who want to help build a great and enduring company and deploy Deep Learning to the world!

About the Role

As Director of Operations, UK you will help build and lead the field operations team that installs and maintains Focal Systems shelf cameras across our UK retail partners. Our cameras are being deployed at scale, with 100,000+ units live or rolling out at leading retailers around the world, and the UK is a major part of that growth.

You will support the running of UK operations end to end: the people, the processes, the metrics, and the customer outcomes. You will work closely with senior and executive leadership to set and roll out operational strategy, and with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to make every deployment faster, more reliable, and more cost-effective than the last.

You will be joining an established, experienced team that works in cycles. Retailer rollouts bring periods of rapid scale-up, followed by quieter maintenance periods where we scale back down, and those transitions have not always been smooth. A key part of this role is making them smoother: planning ahead for each change in pace, keeping the team steady and supported through it, and building processes that let us ramp up and down without losing quality or momentum.

This is a senior leadership role. You will develop our existing team, support during scale-up and scale-down periods, set the operating rhythm for field work, and be the person our customers and colleagues rely on when something needs to get done.

What We Are Looking For

  • You are a hands-on operations leader who has scaled field teams and processes, and you are as comfortable working with stakeholders at different levels
  • You run operations on data: you define the right metrics, watch them closely, and act early when they move
  • You build structure where there is none, designing roles, workflows, and SOPs that hold up as volume grows and priorities shift
  • You hire well, coach well, and build teams that take ownership without needing to be chased
  • You understand that operations is a customer-facing function, and you take pride in exceeding what our retail partners expect
  • You thrive in a fast-moving, remote-first environment and are energised by building something new

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own ongoing field-service performance and SLA delivery, prioritising maintenance work and driving issues through to resolution.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing UK field operations team responsible for installing and maintaining shelf cameras at scale
  • Own the operational plan for UK deployments, from scheduling and logistics through installation, quality checks, and ongoing maintenance
  • Define, track, and report on the key metrics for field performance and SLA adherence
  • Partner with executive leadership to set performance goals, budgets, and long-term operational strategy for the UK
  • Analyse operational processes end to end, identify bottlenecks, and lead improvements that increase speed, quality, and efficiency
  • Work across Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Customer Success to feed field insights back into hardware, software, and deployment playbooks
  • Act as the senior escalation point for operational and customer issues, removing blockers quickly and owning the outcome
  • Build strong relationships with retail partners, understand their store operations, agree success criteria, and deliver against them
  • Manage relationships with any third-party installers or service partners, including performance, quality, and cost
  • Establish safe working practices and ensure field activity meets health and safety requirements at every retailer site

Requirements

  • 5+ years in an operations leadership role, with a track record of managing people, processes, and budgets
  • Experience leading field operations, installation, or service teams across multiple sites, ideally deploying hardware at scale
  • Strong working knowledge of core operational functions, including finance and budgeting, customer service, logistics, and people management
  • Proven ability to plan and run operations for efficiency and productivity, using data and KPIs to drive decisions
  • Experience designing and implementing new structures, roles, and processes that support rapid growth and shifting business needs
  • Solid understanding of account management and customer success, and comfort working directly with senior customer stakeholders
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to present clearly to executives, customers, and field teams
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and travel regularly within the UK

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of retail or grocery operations
  • Familiarity with retail technology such as shopper-facing apps, back-room inventory management, or POS systems
  • Experience managing third-party installers, contractors, or service partners
  • Lean Six Sigma or a similar process improvement certification
  • Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment

 

Why Focal Systems

Strong Values and Mission - We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception.

Exceptional Team - We are a team of hard-working, fun-loving professionals from some of the most eminent universities, research labs, and tech companies of our time. We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art.

Outstanding Partners - We work with 10+ of the largest retailers in the world and have a world-class roster of investors, advisors and partners to support & advise us in our endeavors.

What we offer
We care deeply about the health, happiness, and wellbeing of all of our employees. We offer:    

  • Competitive Salary & Attractive Stock
  • Generous Paid Time Off 
  • Pension
  • Sick Leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Learning and Development Budget

title: Responsable du restaurant ("Club Manager") - Soho House Paris H/F
description:
En tant que Club manager, vous êtes un ambassadeur de la marque et possédez une connaissance approfondie du groupe Soho House et de son concept, y compris l’ensemble des menus et de l’offre de restauration. Faisant preuve d’un professionnalisme irréprochable envers nos managers, nos collaborateurs et nos clients, vous êtes chargé(e) de la gestion quotidienne du Club, de l’organisation des événements qui y sont associés, ainsi que de l’expérience des membres et de leurs invités. Vous veiller au quotidien à ce que l’ensemble de l’équipe du Club fasse preuve d’une attitude positive, en accord avec les valeurs de Soho House Paris.

 Missions principales et responsabilités

  • Superviser les activités afférentes à la Restauration précisément du Club, du Bar et du Cabaret

  • Être en charge de la coordination entre tous les départements et plus particulièrement entre le Club, le Bar et les Evènements
  • Superviser et faire le suivi des approvisionnements, des commandes, des stocks et des inventaires en vue de respecter le budget alloué et les « costs »
  • Être en mesure d’expliquer les ventes, les chiffres d’affaires et les écarts stocks-inventaires pour les rapports financiers hebdomadaires et mensuels
  • Veiller à atteindre les objectifs financiers alloués aux espaces restauration, à les dépasser et être capable d’apporter des solutions en cas de retards financiers
  • Connaître les différents coûts et dépenses des espaces de restauration pour faire le suivi avec le département Financier et la Direction
  • Elaborer conjointement avec la Direction du Soho House Paris et la Direction Financière le budget du département restauration
  • Calculer et connaître les besoins en cours et futurs en termes d’équipements, ustensiles et linges, superviser les commandes
  • Être en charge des projets des espaces restauration, du suivi et de l’avancé des projets (concepts éphémères, soirées exceptionnelles, animations saisonnières, etc.)
  • Superviser la relation des équipes de la restauration avec les membres en veillant à ce que les commentaires, les avis et feedbacks soient pris en compte en vue d’assurer une offre de service satisfaisante pour la clientèle
  • Faire part à sa hiérarchie des retours de la clientèle et des équipes, proposer des améliorations, des solutions en fonction des points mentionnés
  • Connaître et appliquer quotidiennement les règles en matière de normes HACCP, de régimes alimentaires et allergènes, et les règles liées à la consommation d’alcool tout en respectant les législations en vigueur
  • Maîtriser les standards et techniques de services tout en ayant une connaissance accrue des produits, des recettes
  • Connaître les fournisseurs, leurs tarifs et leurs offres, rechercher de nouveaux fournisseurs pour négocier les tarifs
  • Mettre en place et conduire les formations pour les équipes supervisées et les équipes de la House en coordonnant la mise en place des formations mensuelles « Cook House» et « House Tonic » ainsi que les formations techniques de service et autres formations dispensées par Soho House et Soho House Paris
  • Assister à toutes les dégustations des menus élaborés par le Chef Exécutif, collaborer avec le Chef Exécutif sur les menus en proposants des conseils avisés et faire un retour constructif à la Direction quant aux dégustations, saisonnalités des produits, qualités des produits et retours éventuels des membres
  • S’assurer et effectuer les contrôles et les inspections des installations et équipements techniques des espaces restauration, de sécurité et coordonner avec le département de la Maintenance pour maintenir les équipements et matériels en bon état (réparations, installations de nouvel équipement, contrôles préventifs, etc.)
  • Coordonner la mise en place des briefings quotidiens avec les équipes restauration pour améliorer la communication des les services, organiser une réunion mensuelle avec les équipes encadrantes de la restauration pour transmettre les informations et les projets à venir au sein du département et de la House
  • Se tenir informé(e) des rapports « Mystery Guest » et audits internes pour agir sur les axes d’amélioration et faire un retour aux équipes
  • Veillez à ce que les règles en matière de santé et de sécurité, pour le département de la Restauration soient respectées à tout moment
  • Superviser avec les responsables du Club et du Bar la mise en place et l’application des procédures internes propres aux espaces de restauration en respectant les normes HACCP, d’hygiène et de sécurité
  • Connaître les règles de planification du personnel, faire le suivi des équipes (administratif et disciplinaire) et des absences et coordonner avec le département People & Development pour l’élaboration de la Paie, l’arrivée des nouveaux membres de l’équipe et des rapports de fin de mois
  • Savoir s’exprimer en public et entretenir un bon relationnel avec les équipes et les membres
  • Se tenir à jour et informé(e) des tendances culinaires et autres concepts en lien avec la restauration et la gastronomie
  • Maîtriser le logiciels informatiques (MS Office, logiciel de recrutement, de gestion du restaurant MICROS, etc.)
  • S’assurer de la satisfaction des membres et des équipes à tout moment, aider les équipes opérationnelles si nécessaire

Profil :

  • Avoir déjà travaillé en tant que Responsable de restaurant ou rôle similaire au sein d’un hôtel ou d'un restaurant réalisant du volume
  • Avoir de l’aisance avec les logiciels de management tels que : OpenTable, Micros
  • Avoir de l’aisance avec les chiffres, maitrise global des coûts du service
  • Être un bon communiquant et avoir de l’aisance relationnelle
  • Faire preuve de leadership auprès des équipes, les fédérer
  • Avoir encadrer une équipe d'au moins 20 collaborateurs
  • Avoir la capacité de travailler durant les horaires d’ouvertures (soirs, weekends, vacances scolaires)
  • Un diplôme en hôtellerie et restauration est un plus
  • Maitrise du français et de l'anglais obligatoire

 

Avantages :

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.
  • Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.
  • Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.
  • Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
  • Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field
  • Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts
  • Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level
  • Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field
  • Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on
  • Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments
  • EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools
  • UAV flight testing and validation in operational environments
  • Experience with datalinks and radio systems
  • Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan 
  • Extended social security package 
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

title: Software Engineer I (New Grad 2027) - Instruments team
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

We’re excited to welcome a new cohort of graduates with a computer science or related major who are ready to leverage their skills to drive real-world impact and shape the future of finance!

In our hybrid early career program, you’ll be paired with a tenured Affirmer and have an opportunity to collaborate in-person 3 days a week out of our London office. You'll experience the best of both worlds: the in-office experience and remote work. After the one-year, you can remain hybrid, go remote, or stay in an office. Opportunities are available across different tech stacks and teams so that you can find a perfect fit to launch your career with Affirm!


What You'll Do

  • With the support of your team, you will work on tasks that contribute to the team's projects and goals.
  • You will work collaboratively and proactively with your team and stakeholders, bringing them along for your work and helping to create visibility and dialog regarding the risks and trade-offs related to your work. 
  • You will strike the right balance of speed and quality in your work, ensuring that we hit our business goals while protecting our systems from downtime.
  • You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities. 


What We Look For

  • You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
  • You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

GBR base pay range per year: £80,000 - 118,000 

Location (Hybrid): London 

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.

Why this role, why now

Our robots produce data no lab can stage. Our fleet has recorded more than 500 million manipulation interactions in live warehouse operations; Cortex 2.0 was trained on a curated 10 million of them and added a world model that plans before it acts (arXiv 2604.20246). Cortex 2.5 learns a new task from a few demonstrations instead of a training run. Deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the research team is growing with them.

We now want one scientific leader who owns the research behind Cortex end to end and turns what our fleet experiences every day into the next step change in what robots can do.

The Real-World Learning Loop is your system

Sereact is a frontier research lab and a production-grade robotics company in one. Our bet: general-purpose robotic intelligence “must be learned from live deployments” (The Real-World Learning Loop, Feb 2026). Every stage of that loop is yours to raise:

  • In-Situ Policy Execution. Every robot in production runs the current policy, and every shift is an experiment. You decide what the policies expose for learning.

  • Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own interactions while they work. You decide what is worth recording and which situations the fleet should go and find.

  • Data Curation and Learning. Novelty, uncertainty, failures and distribution shift decide what we learn from. You own the curation and the training recipe.

  • Evaluation and Policy Redeployment. Updated policies pass validation gates before they return to the fleet. You set the bar, and how fast we can clear it safely.

Every deployment teaches the next one. Your job is to make that loop turn faster and teach more each time.

Die Stelle ist in Stuttgart angesiedelt und eignet sich ideal für jemanden, der gerne strukturierte Prozesse aufbaut, kaufmännische Aufgaben steuert und ein Team unterstützt, das an modernster Technologie arbeitet. description: Staff Product Manager, Product Discovery Engine About Us Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things. Job Summary We’re looking for a systems-minded Staff Product Manager to take Constructor’s search and discovery to the state of the art — and keep it there — across every retail industry we serve. This is a highly technical, high-leverage role at the core of our Product Discovery Engine chapter: the teams responsible for how we retrieve, understand, and rank the right products for every shopper, on every query, for every customer. Your job is to raise discovery quality and, through it, our customers’ business metrics. You won’t be measured on features shipped — you’ll be measured on relevance and business outcomes, like conversion, revenue per visit, and search-attributed GMV, moving up. You’ll start embedded with our Search Quality team, owning its strategy and roadmap and getting deep into the systems that decide what shoppers actually see. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Product Discovery Engine chapter — deciding where we’re heading and why across recall, ranking, query understanding, personalization, and the ML infrastructure underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership. Search at Constructor is fundamentally a machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes ML. You’ll partner closely with ML, data science, and engineering to turn the latest research into production wins, keep us ahead of both commercial competitors and academic state of the art, and be the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams — ML Recall, ML Infra, and, over time, teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management — behind a single, coherent vision for great discovery. If you’re excited about driving innovation across dozens of the world’s largest retailers, being held to relevance and business outcomes, and pushing an already best-in-class product further ahead, this role is for you. What You’ll Do Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in search-attributed conversion, revenue per visit, and GMV alongside relevance across our customer base. Deliver across every retail industry. Move quality and business metrics across all the verticals we serve, accounting for the differences in catalog, language, and shopper intent. Keep us at the state of the art. Continuously translate the latest ML / IR research and competitive moves into production wins, and ship SOTA ML / LLM-assisted capabilities that beat our previous best on relevance. Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for the Product Discovery Engine — where we’re heading and why — tie it directly to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it. Lead Search Quality first. Own its strategy and roadmap, driving measurable improvements in the relevance and correctness of results. Orchestrate across the pipeline. Unify recall, ranking, query understanding, and personalization behind one definition of quality and one set of business metrics, so improvements compound instead of colliding. Turn ML research into production wins. Partner deeply with ML and data science to take models — from candidate generation and recall to LLM-assisted interpretation — from idea to production, balancing accuracy, latency, and cost. Make quality measurable and explainable. Build the metrics, evaluation frameworks, and tooling the whole chapter uses to measure, attribute, and explain discovery quality and its business impact. Own quality under pressure. Lead investigation and triage when issues arise, and design durable, systemic fixes rather than one-off patches. Grow the mandate. Expand into chapter-wide leadership spanning ML Recall, ML Infra, and — over time — teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management. What Success Looks Like Within your first year, you will have: Driven measurable lift in search-attributed conversion and revenue per visit — moving business metrics, not just quality metrics. Driven measurable business-metric lift (conversion, revenue per visit, GMV) and relevance lift across every major retail vertical we serve . Shipped at least one state-of-the-art ML / LLM-assisted capability into production that beats our previous best on relevance. Won head-to-head quality benchmarks against every major competitor in the verticals we compete in, with a repeatable, defensible methodology. Taken core quality metrics to best-in-class levels and kept them improving quarter over quarter. Stood up an evaluation framework and tooling that ties model and system investments directly to customer business outcomes . What We’re Looking For Extensive product management experience (typically 8+ years) in search, discovery, ML, or NLP-heavy products, including time operating at a senior or staff level. A track record of moving business metrics at scale — conversion, revenue, engagement — not just shipping features, and of setting strategy across multiple teams. Deep understanding of the end-to-end search pipeline: query interpretation → recall / candidate generation → ranking → reranking → personalization → delivery. Strong ML product depth — owning production models and reasoning about tradeoffs between high-capacity (LLM / batch) and low-latency (real-time) approaches — and a habit of staying current with state-of-the-art research. Fluency with retrieval and recall, query understanding (tokenization, synonyms, spelling correction, multilingual support), and search evaluation frameworks. A rigorous, measurement-first mindset that ties every quality investment back to business outcomes. Excellent cross-functional leadership — able to align teams with different goals behind a shared definition of quality and a shared set of business metrics, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, data science, and ML Ops. Comfort operating with ambiguity, setting direction where none exists yet, and leading through clarity and credibility rather than the org chart. Benefits Unlimited vacation time — we strongly encourage all of our employees to take at least 3 weeks per year. A competitive compensation package including stock options. Company-sponsored US health coverage (100% paid for employee). Fully remote team — choose where you live. Work-from-home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office. Apple laptops provided for new employees. Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year. Parental leave for qualified employees. Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact. This position is fully remote — Constructor.io is a remote-first company. Partner with FP&A to ensure accurate GL and cost-center coding, timely financial information, and a reliable month-end close. Maintain clear accounting records, support audit requests, and document processes to ensure continuity and effective controls. Build an AI-Native Accounting Function Use n8n, AI tools, and modern accounting platforms to identify opportunities for automation and continuously improve workflows. Validate AI-generated outputs, prioritize human review where risks are highest, and maintain reliable evidence for stakeholders, regulators, and auditors. Help scale accounting processes across our growing multi-entity business, with opportunities to broaden your expertise into AR and revenue accounting over time. Nice-to-haves 🛠️ Modern finance tools: You've worked with AI-native ERPs, Ramp or similar P2P platforms, Q2C tools, or workflow automation platforms like n8n. 🌍 International accounting: You have experience working across multiple entities, ideally in a global business with an expanding international footprint. 💰 SaaS & revenue accounting: You're familiar with SaaS business models, multi-currency accounting, AR, or revenue recognition. 🔍 Audit & qualifications: You bring an audit background or relevant accounting qualifications that strengthen your accounting expertise. 🇩🇪 German language skills: You can communicate in German, although this is not required for the role. Why join us? At n8n, you won't just process transactions — you'll help rethink how accounting works at an automation company. You'll own meaningful parts of our accounting operations, build AI-powered improvements you can see in action, and help shape a scalable finance function at one of Europe's fastest-growing startups. You'll join a supportive, remote-first team where autonomy, curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning are encouraged. Working closely with experienced colleagues, you'll have the opportunity to deepen your GL, P2P, and close expertise while gradually expanding into AR and revenue accounting as we grow. Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on? Apply now — and help us build the future of AI-native accounting. n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. Our company language is English. You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ( https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35 ). Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. Benefits Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay. Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity. Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge: Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are. US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are. Health & wellness 🩺 – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US : Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage. Future planning 💰 – Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.* US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match. Financial security 🛡️ – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones. Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills. A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it! Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description. Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about. Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang. *Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement. title: Software Development Engineer III, Maps API
description: Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. The Maps API team builds and maintains the applications and infrastructure responsible for creating and distributing Mapbox maps . Thousands of customers rely on our services to seamlessly handle billions of requests every day, scale in real-time to global events, and enable designers, developers, and analysts to make and share maps we’ve never dreamed of. Delivering maps means delivering a model of the world that’s changing all the time and needs to automatically support the world’s edge cases – writing systems, fonts, local regulations, and global boundary disputes. Our team maintains the highest-traffic read APIs at Mapbox and the distributed ETL pipelines used by internal and external customers to turn data into maps. We’re building new ways for people to visualize location data. Check out our Mapbox maps ! As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow. What You’ll Do As a Software Development Engineer III on the Maps API team, you will be responsible for balancing rapid development of new mapping tools against the reliability of our services as they scale into new request volumes, markets, and use cases. In a single week on the Maps API team, you might write application code robust to a world’s worth of data, build and deploy microservices, diagnose complex system behavior as global markets drive traffic in unexpected ways, or facilitate continuous delivery at Mapbox. In this role, you can expect to: Lead your engineering team to identify and scope out well-defined tasks. Execute on the scope and be accountable for delivering on time with quality. Design systems and make architectural decisions that will keep pace with the rapid growth of Mapbox’s customer base. Mentor your peers through 1:1s, facilitating design and code reviews, and providing continuous guidance to foster professional growth and technical excellence. Promote a culture of operational excellence by meticulously testing and monitoring our systems and code, writing documentation, and being on-call to support the health of our services. Reduce technical debt, share your knowledge, and invest in your teammates’ health and happiness, while optimizing application performance and accelerating feature velocity. Uphold a culture of collaboration, transparency, creativity, inclusion, and data-driven decisions. What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role 8-10+ years of experience building scalable high volume low latency backend services. Proficiency with Python, NodeJS, and native AWS (CDK, ECS, Step Functions, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, CloudFront). Experience building mapping and geospatial related products. Familiarity with code versioning tools, such as GitHub. Able to perform independently all the development tasks, based on designs and specs. Self-starter who is communication and outcomes-oriented. An empirical analytical approach. You develop strong hypotheses, conduct spikes, and clearly communicate your findings. A desire to share your expertise through documentation, mentorship, pairing, and both written and verbal discussion. A desire to work with and lead individuals with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. High quality mindset -- write unit tests, proactively remedy defects and follow through to production. Nice to Have Traits for This Role Proficiency in C++ What We Value In addition to our core values , which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders: We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities. We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people. We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company. We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply. How we support you Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable. raw.title: Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React – Berlin
raw.description:
Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React – Berlin

Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD

  • Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit

  • Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote

  • Standort: Berlin-Zehlendorf, direkt am S-Bahnhof Zehlendorf (S1)

  • Produkt: Konsentas, ein Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement für Behörden

  • Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle

Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen

  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen

  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln

  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen

  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden

  • Unsere zwei Auszubildenden im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)

  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für unsere Azubis eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)

  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID

  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework

  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.

  • JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab

  • Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL

  • Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD

  • Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1

  • Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch

  • Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.

  • Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen bei uns genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design

-

Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.

Dein Team

Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Daniel (Developer Lead), Nico (Geschäftsführer & Projektmanager), der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Daniel und Nico übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.

Was wir bieten

  • Ein sinnstiftendes Produkt, das täglich in Bürgerämtern genutzt wird, in einem krisensicheren Markt

  • Echter Einfluss auf technische Entscheidungen und eine Modernisierung mit klarem Ziel

  • 30 Urlaubstage

  • Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit ab 10 Uhr, 2 Remote-Tage pro Woche

  • Weiterbildung während der Arbeitszeit, z. B. Udemy-Kurse; eigene Vorschläge sind willkommen

  • Claude-Lizenz, offen für weitere Tools

  • Hardware: Lenovo ThinkPad, offen für Vorschläge

  • UrbanSportsClub und JobRad

  • Gute Anbindung: S1 und Busse M48, 101, 115

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Kennenlerngespräch mit Sara

  2. Technisches Interview mit Live-Projektarbeit mit Nico und Daniel

  3. Teamgespräch vor Ort

  4. Angebot

Über Girona

Seit über 25 Jahren entwickelt die Girona Softwareentwicklung GmbH in Berlin Software für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Städte wie Berlin, München, Bonn und Dessau setzen seit Jahrzehnten auf unsere Lösungen, Konsentas etwa in Bürgerämtern, Gesundheitsämtern sowie Kfz-Zulassungs- und Führerscheinstellen.

title: (Senior) Strategic Partner Manager:in (m|w|d)
description: idealo arbeitet mit einem breiten Spektrum des E-Commerce-Marktes zusammen - von internationalen Plattformen und großen Onlinehändlern bis hin zu Affiliate-Netzwerken, Agenturen und Technologiepartnern. Im Mittelpunkt dieser Rolle steht die strategische Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung relevanter Affiliate-Advertiser. Du entwickelst bestehendes Geschäft, erschließt neue Umsatz- und Wachstumspotenziale, auch über ergänzende Lösungen wie Retail Media, und gestaltest langfristig erfolgreiche Partnerschaften. Ergänzend entwickelst Du die Zusammenarbeit mit Netzwerken, Agenturen und weiteren Multiplikatoren weiter, um zusätzliche Geschäftspotenziale zu erschließen. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest und entwickelst Dein Account-Portfolio eigenständig und priorisierst Deine Aktivitäten nach wirtschaftlichem Potenzial und strategischer Relevanz. Du baust langfristige Beziehungen zu Deinen Partnern auf, verstehst ihre Geschäftsmodelle und entwickelst daraus konkrete Wachstums-, Monetarisierungs- und Cross-Selling-Ansätze. Du trägst Verantwortung für Umsatz und Profitabilität Deiner Accounts und führst Vertrags- und Konditionsverhandlungen eigenständig. Du steuerst Deine Partnerschaften datenbasiert anhand relevanter KPIs wie GMV, Conversion Rate, CPO/CPC, Approval- und Stornoquote und leitest daraus Optimierungs-, Skalierungs- und Verhandlungsansätze ab. Du identifizierst zusätzliche Potenziale, z. B. über Retail Media, Sortimentsentwicklung oder strategische Projekte, und setzt diese gemeinsam mit Partnern und internen Expert:innen um. Du arbeitest eng mit Product, Tech, Operations, Analytics, Retail Media und weiteren Sales-Bereichen zusammen. Ergänzend entwickelst Du Kooperationen mit Affiliate-Netzwerken, Agenturen und Technologiepartnern, um zusätzliche Advertiser und skalierbare Geschäftspotenziale zu erschließen. Das bringst du mit Du übernimmst Verantwortung und treibst Themen eigenständig voran. Du verfügst über mehrjährige relevante Erfahrung im Partner Management, (Key) Account Management oder beratungsorientierten Vertrieb und hast bereits eigenständig kommerziell relevante Accounts verantwortet. Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für E-Commerce und Performance Marketing mit und kannst Kennzahlen wie CPO, CPC, CVR, KUR, Umsatz und Marge sicher für kommerzielle Entscheidungen nutzen. Erfahrung mit Affiliate Marketing oder Retail Media ist ein Plus. Du kannst anhand konkreter Beispiele zeigen, wie Du Partnerbeziehungen entwickelt und Umsatz, Profitabilität oder strategischen Mehrwert gesteigert hast. Du verbindest ausgeprägtes Account Management mit analytischem und kommerziellem Denken und kannst Partner überzeugend für neue Lösungen gewinnen. Du kommunizierst und verhandelst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und trittst souverän gegenüber unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und Entscheidungsebenen auf. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert und setzt auch bei mehreren Accounts und Projekten klare Prioritäten. Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen, insbesondere Salesforce, ist von Vorteil. Du erfüllst nicht alle Kriterien? Keine Sorge, wir suchen Mitarbeiter:innen, die uns mit ihrer Persönlichkeit überzeugen und motiviert sind, gemeinsam mit ihrem Team alles zu geben! Bei idealo erwartet dich Du willst dich weiterbilden? Wir nehmen deine persönlichen Entwicklungsziele ernst und bieten dir neben unserem idealo Learning Hub, eLearning Angeboten (z.B. Udemy), Coachings & Mediation auch die Möglichkeit individuell von unserem Weiterbildungsbudget zu profitieren. Und was kann das Büro? Unser Büro, im Herzen Berlins, bietet neben dem “Standard-Kicker” auch hervorragendes kostenfreies Mittagessen, sowie kostenfreien Kaffee, Limonade und Feierabend-Bier. Dabei kannst du auf unserer wunderschönen Dachterrasse mit Kolleg:innen aus unserer Unternehmensgruppe netzwerken. Du wünschst dir Unterstützung auch außerhalb der Arbeit? Eine kostenlose Beratung, sowie Unterstützung in allen Lebenslagen (beruflich, privat, familiär, gesundheitlich etc.) bieten wir in Zusammenarbeit mit dem pme-Familienservice . Du willst auch mobil sein? Mit Job-Bike oder Deutschlandticket kein Problem – und das ist auch noch umweltfreundlich! Du möchtest dich fit halten? Hierzu bieten wir dir viele unterschiedliche Fitness- und Sportmöglichkeiten wie zum Beispiel eine Urban Sports oder Gympass Mitgliedschaft für deine ganz persönlichen Bedürfnisse an. Und was gibt es noch? Selbstverständlich müssen Erfolge gefeiert werden! Neben Team-Events erwarten dich auch große Company-Events, bei denen wir keine Kosten und Mühen scheuen. #LI-MR1 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Testeur QA Junior (H/F) - Débutants & reconversions
description: Qui sommes-nous ? N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers. Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, nos solutions N2F et Keeple s’imposent comme des références sur le marché français. N2F est une solution complète de gestion des dépenses professionnelles (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs), et Keeple centralise la gestion RH du quotidien (congés, absences, temps de travail) le tout dans une interface simple, intuitive et 100% connectée (app web et mobile). Portés par une équipe engagée, qui place l’humain au centre de ses priorités, nous poursuivons une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnel Nous cherchons actuellement un(e) Testeur QA pour nous accompagner dans notre développement. Ta mission sera de garantir la qualité de nos solutions pour assurer la satisfaction de nos clients. Tes principales missions seront : Concevoir des scénarios de tests à partir des analyses rédigées par les équipes produit, Exécuter les cas de test fonctionnels sur différentes versions de notre logiciel, Identifier, qualifier les anomalies, et suivre leur correction en collaboration directe avec les développeurs, Réaliser des tests de non-régression et collaborer avec nos automaticiens afin d’augmenter la couverture de nos tests automatisés, Suivre et documenter les résultats des tests, Proposer et mettre en œuvre des actions qualité, préventives ou correctives, S’assurer en permanence des bonnes performances du logiciel, Faire le lien entre les équipes consulting/support et développement. En résumé tu joueras un rôle essentiel dans le cycle de vie du développement de nos logiciels en garantissant que nos produits répondent aux normes de qualités requises avant d’être déployés à nos clients. Ce qu’on va attendre de toi : Ton diplôme importe peu : ta motivation et ton envie d’apprendre font la différence, Tu es curieux(se), rigoureux(se) et aimes comprendre comment les choses fonctionnent, Tu es à l’aise avec les outils informatiques et fais preuve d’autonomie, Tu as un bon esprit d’analyse et un bon sens de la communication, Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et la résolution de problèmes. Si tu es force de proposition, que tu aimes travailler en équipe et résoudre des problèmes alors n’hésite plus et rejoins nous ! Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? L’opportunité de rejoindre une entreprise en pleine croissance et de contribuer directement à la qualité d’un logiciel utilisé au quotidien par nos clients, Un rôle à fort impact sur le produit, au cœur des échanges entre les équipes produit, développement, support et consulting, Un poste clé où tes analyses, tes idées et tes propositions d’amélioration qualité sont écoutées et mises en œuvre, La possibilité de monter en compétences sur les tests fonctionnels, la non régression et l’automatisation, Et bien sûr, une équipe dynamique avec une ambiance start-up, collaborative et bienveillante. Tu bénéficieras également : Une prime de vacances, Des chèques cadeaux à Noël, Des chèques de rentrée scolaire (si tu as des enfants), Un chèque culture, Des cours de musique, Un évènement par mois dont une soirée festive chaque trimestre. 1 jour de télétravail par semaine N2JSOFT s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité hommes-femmes et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés. #N2JSOFTFR Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Human Resource Director, Europe & Canada
description:
Join New Era Technology, where People First is at the heart of everything we do. With a global team of over 3,000 professionals, we're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and inspired to grow. Our mission is to securely connect people, places, and information with end-to-end technology solutions at scale.

At New Era, you'll join a team-oriented culture that prioritizes your personal and professional development. Work alongside industry-certified experts, access continuous training, and enjoy competitive benefits. Guided by our core attributes — putting people first, embracing continuous learning, and thriving through collaboration and inclusion — we nurture our people to deliver exceptional customer service.

If you want to make an impact in a supportive, growth-oriented environment, New Era is the place for you. Apply today and help us shape the future of work—together

 

The Human Resources Director, Europe & Canada is responsible for leading the HR strategy, operations, and employee experience across Canada, the United Kingdom, Belgium, and Romania. This position serves as the senior HR leader for the region and partners closely with business leaders to align people strategies with organizational priorities, business growth, and operational objectives.

Reporting directly to the Chief Human Resources Officer in the United States, the HR Director will provide leadership across employee relations, talent acquisition, organizational design, workforce planning, talent and leadership development, succession planning, payroll oversight, employment compliance, and general HR operations.

The successful candidate will bring strong experience operating in a complex, multi-country environment and will balance strategic leadership with effective day-to-day HR execution. The role will lead regional HR resources while collaborating closely with global HR, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Legal, and business leadership.

This Human Resources Director, Europe & Canada will have 3 direct reports and serves approximately 250 employees in the region. 

PRIMARY DUTIES:

Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership

  • Serve as the senior HR leader for Canada, the UK, Belgium, and Romania, providing strategic HR direction across the region. Other countries with small numbers of staff include France, Ireland, and the Netherlands.
  • Partner with EOR vendors for employment needs in countries outside of the company’s operations.
  • Partner with senior leaders and managers to translate business priorities into people strategies that drive growth, engagement, and performance.
  • Use workforce data and insights to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, and adapt global HR initiatives to country-specific needs.

HR Operations & Regional Leadership

  • Lead regional HR operations, ensuring consistent, scalable, and employee-focused HR practices across the employee lifecycle.
  • Lead and develop the regional HR team, including HR Managers in the UK and Romania and an HR Coordinator in Romania.
  • Partner with global HR to standardize and continuously improve processes while addressing local requirements.

Employee Relations

  • Lead employee relations matters across the region, including disciplinary actions, grievances, investigations, redundancies, and dismissals.
  • Coach managers to address employee relations and performance issues consistently, with appropriate documentation and escalation.
  • Partner with General Counsel and external counsel on employment-related claims and proactively reduce employment risk.

Talent Acquisition & Onboarding

  • Own regional recruitment and onboarding of top talent in partnership with offshore recruiters and hiring managers.
  • Build talent pipelines for critical roles and ensure hiring practices and documentation meet local requirements.

Talent Development, Succession & Career Planning

  • Lead employee development, succession planning, career pathing, and leadership development across the region.
  • Facilitate talent reviews with leaders to identify critical roles, high-potential employees, and capability gaps.

Payroll & HR Administration

  • Oversee regional payroll administration in partnership with the offshore payroll specialist team.
  • Maintain strong controls and coordination between HR, Payroll, and Finance for accurate employee transactions.

Employment Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure HR practices comply with employment requirements in Canada, the UK, Belgium, and Romania.
  • Monitor legislative developments and recommend updates to policies, documentation, and manager practices.
  • Support compliance for working time, leave, employee consultation, restructurings, redundancies, and terminations.

Organizational Effectiveness & Workforce Planning

  • Provide guidance on organizational structure, spans of control, and workforce planning to support growth and scalability.
  • Support integrations, restructurings, acquisitions, and related change and communication strategies within the region.

 

EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

  • Significant progressive HR leadership experience, including experience at the HR Director, Head of HR, Senior HR Business Partner, or comparable level.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting employees and leaders across multiple countries or jurisdictions.
  • Strong working knowledge of employment practices and employee relations within the UK and broader European environment.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex employee relations matters, including investigations, disciplinary matters, grievances, redundancies, and dismissals.
  • Experience partnering with senior business leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, restructuring, and talent strategy.
  • Experience leading and developing HR professionals.
  • Strong understanding of recruitment, onboarding, performance management, succession planning and employee development.
  • Experience providing oversight or governance for payroll and HR operational processes.
  • Strong judgment and demonstrated ability to handle confidential and sensitive employee matters.
  • Excellent communication, influencing, consultation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively within a global organization and collaborate across countries, cultures, and time zones.

Preferred

  • Direct HR experience supporting employees in Canada, the United Kingdom, Belgium, and/or Romania.
  • Experience within a global professional services, technology services, managed services, or similarly complex organization.
  • Experience supporting acquisitions, integrations, restructurings, or other large-scale organizational transformation.
  • Experience working within a global HR operating model that uses shared-services or offshore recruiting, payroll, or HR operations teams.

LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES:

  • Strategic Business Partnership: Connects workforce and organizational decisions directly to business priorities and outcomes.
  • Commercial Acumen: Understands how talent, organizational structure, workforce costs, and leadership capability affect business performance.
  • Employment Risk Judgment: Balances employee experience, business objectives, consistency, and employment risk when advising leaders.
  • Influence & Credibility: Builds trusted relationships with senior executives, managers, employees, and global functional partners.
  • Change Leadership: Effectively leads organizations and employees through transformation, restructuring, integration, and growth.
  • Talent Mindset: Proactively develops internal talent and strengthens leadership pipelines and succession plans.
  • Operational Excellence: Creates consistent, scalable HR processes while recognizing when local requirements require different approaches.
  • Global & Cultural Awareness: Works effectively across countries and cultures and avoids applying a single-country approach to regional workforce matters.
  • Sound Judgment & Discretion: Demonstrates maturity and confidentiality when handling sensitive employee and legal matters.

 

LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to read, understand, and interpret job-related documents, instructions, policies, and communications in English. Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing, with employees, customers, vendors, and other business partners, as applicable to the position. Fluent English is required. Fluent or professional-level French language capability is preferred.

REQUIRED EDUCATION / CERTIFICATIONS: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Organizational Development, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Preferred: CIPD or an equivalent internationally recognized HR credential.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Regular use of hands and fingers to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment, including repetitive motions such as typing, scrolling, and mouse use. Ability to communicate effectively and understand verbal communication in person, by telephone, and through video conferencing or other remote communication tools. Ability to view and read information on computer screens and printed materials, including the ability to adjust focus. The position requires prolonged periods of computer use and viewing a computer screen.

WORK ENVIRONMENT: Remote

EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK: This position generally operates during normal business hours; however, specific start and end times may vary based on business needs, workload, and job responsibilities. Occasional work outside of normal business hours may be required.

TRAVEL: Occasional trips to Belgium and Romania may be required. 

SALARY:  This role will have 3 direct reports and serve approximately 250 people in the region.  Salary is $75,000 £ - $85,000 £

title: Senior Associate - Materials
description:
Company Description: Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.

As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.

 

Strategy Associate, Materials & Circular Economy

Location: London preferred. Amsterdam also possible

Systemiq is looking for a Strategy Associate to join our Materials & Circular Economy team. This role is suited to someone who combines strong strategic thinking with the intellectual curiosity to tackle complex sustainability challenges.

You will work on some of the most important questions facing companies, governments and wider society as they shift towards more circular and sustainable models. Projects can range from shaping corporate strategy and identifying new business opportunities to assessing value chains, developing policy recommendations and designing system-level interventions.

We are looking for someone who can bring the core toolkit and pace of a strong strategy consultant: structured problem-solving, analytical rigour, clear communication and sound judgement. Strategy consulting experience is one route to demonstrating this. We are equally interested in candidates from other demanding analytical environments who can show the same quality of thinking and ability to turn complexity into clear recommendations.

You will join small, senior-led project teams and take meaningful responsibility from the outset. You will structure problems, conduct analysis, develop insights and work directly with clients to translate those insights into practical strategic choices.

Responsibilities

You will:

  • Structure complex problems: break ambiguous questions into clear workstreams, hypotheses and analytical priorities.

  • Generate insights: conduct rigorous qualitative and quantitative analysis, drawing conclusions from incomplete or complex information.

  • Shape recommendations: translate analysis into clear, concise and practical strategic recommendations.

  • Develop client materials: produce high-quality presentations, briefings and other client-ready outputs.

  • Engage with clients: work directly with senior stakeholders across businesses, governments, foundations and non-governmental organisations.

  • Contribute to project direction: help shape project approaches, hypotheses and emerging strategic conclusions.

  • Build trusted relationships: work effectively with clients, partners and stakeholders across multi-organisation initiatives.

About the team

You will be part of Systemiq's Materials & Circular Economy platform, led by Partner Ben Dixon.

Ben works across circular economy and energy topics and has advised organisations including the Ellen MacArthur Foundation, the United Nations International Resource Panel and multinational companies across packaging, chemicals and related sectors. He also leads Systemiq's work on plastics, focused on accelerating the transition towards a more circular and resource-efficient plastics system.

What we are looking for

Strategy and analytical capability

We are looking for candidates who already demonstrate, or can quickly operate with, the core toolkit expected in strategy consulting. You should be able to:

  • Structure complex and ambiguous problems into clear components, hypotheses and analytical questions.

  • Apply strong analytical judgement to qualitative and quantitative information.

  • Synthesize complex material into concise insights and decision-relevant recommendations.

  • Communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including through high-quality presentation materials.

  • Work effectively at pace, managing changing priorities and imperfect information.

  • Move comfortably between detailed analysis and the broader strategic question.

Experience and background

You will typically bring:

  • At least two years of experience in strategy consulting, advisory or another analytically demanding environment.

  • Evidence of strong performance and increasing responsibility in your previous roles.

  • Experience contributing to strategy, investment, commercial or other decision-focused work.

  • Strong academic achievement, typically including a Master's degree or equivalent experience.

We particularly welcome candidates from strategy consulting, but relevant experience could also come from corporate strategy, investing, high-growth businesses, specialist advisory firms or other project-based environments where structured thinking and analytical rigour are central to the role.

Sector interest and understanding

You do not need to be a specialist across every part of the Materials & Circular Economy agenda. You should, however, bring:

  • An understanding of, or demonstrated ability to learn, complex industrial and consumer value chains.

  • Exposure to sectors such as plastics, petrochemicals, chemicals, consumer goods, manufacturing, mobility, energy or waste management.

  • A strong interest in sustainability, circular economy and the economic and strategic questions involved in system change.

Location

London is the preferred location for this role. We would also consider Amsterdam for candidates whose experience and capabilities are an especially strong match for the position.

Diversity & Inclusion
At Systemiq, we absolutely believe diverse perspectives are essential to driving system change. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people feel respected, supported and able to do their best work.
