raw.description:
Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

· Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%;

· Voordelen: Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer.

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀

title: Stagiair(e) Energie en Leefomgeving
description: 31-38,75 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | € 600,– stagevergoeding | Wo-bachelor/-master | 6-12 maanden Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot De energietransitie is in volle gang. Overheden en bedrijven werken toe naar het behalen van Europese en landelijke doelstellingen, maar dit is vaak makkelijker gezegd dan gedaan. Om beleid tot uitvoering te brengen, moeten uiteenlopende belangen, overtuigingen en visies bijeenkomen. De grenzen tussen beleid en uitvoering zijn daarbij soms vaag. Op dat snijvlak werken wij: wat is de beste strategie om de doelen te behalen, en hoe werken we daar samen naartoe? Daar heb je kennis van de energietransitie voor nodig, maar ook gevoel voor mensen, context en organisaties. Dit is uitdagend, complex en leuk! Wil jij meewerken aan de meest urgente energie- en klimaatvraagstukken van Nederland? Wil jij met frisse ideeën en nieuwe inzichten bijdragen aan oplossingen voor uiteenlopende organisaties? En ben je benieuwd naar het werk bij een adviesbureau? Berenschot biedt jou de kans om tijdens een stage actief mee te werken aan deze complexe en actuele uitdagingen! De startdatum van je stage is 1 oktober 2026 (in overleg). Dit ga je doen Als stagiair(e) werk je onder andere mee aan opdrachten die gaan over energiesystemen, netcongestie, de warmtetransitie, betaalbaarheid en systeemweerbaarheid, op landelijk, regionaal én lokaal niveau. Opdrachtgevers zijn overheden (ministeries, provincies, gemeenten), netbeheerders, energiebedrijven, uitvoeringsorganisaties en woningbouwcorporaties. Daarbij werken we niet alleen voor, maar vooral ook mét onze opdrachtgevers. Een aantal voorbeelden van opdrachten waaraan wij werk(t)en: Het uitdenken en opbouwen van grote nationale uitvoeringsprogramma’s van het Klimaatakkoord, zoals het Nationaal Programma RES, het Nationaal Programma Lokale Warmtetransitie, het Nationaal Plan Energiesysteem, en programma’s rondom hernieuwbare opwek (zon op dak, wind op land, etc.). Het begeleiden van (grote) gemeenten bij het ontwikkelen van een warmte(net)strategie. Het ondersteunen van netbeheerders en provincies bij de ontwikkeling en programmering van het energiesysteem van de toekomst (Energievisies) en het verminderen van netcongestie. Overheden helpen met het opstellen van effectief klimaatbeleid met behulp van prognoses op basis van onze eigen Regionale CO2-routekaart. Het uitvoeren van volumeprojecties voor waterstofdragers richting 2035, om inzicht te krijgen in de verschillende stromen en knelpunten. Het ontwikkelen van een alternatief nettariefstelsel voor netbeheerders, waarmee de netbelasting wordt gespreid en netcongestie wordt beperkt. Overheden helpen met het opstellen en uitvoeren van beleid en plannen om de energietransitie rechtvaardiger te maken (bijvoorbeeld door bestrijding van energiearmoede, de inzet van fix-teams, het sturen op isolatie, etc.) Tijdens jouw stage krijg je de kans om mee te werken aan adviesopdrachten en lever je een bijdrage aan interne projecten, zoals bijvoorbeeld evenementen. Welke adviesopdrachten je doet, bepalen we samen met jou (afhankelijk van jouw interesses, achtergrond en kennis, en welke opdrachten er lopen). Quote “De variatie aan projecten, klanten en collega’s zorgt ervoor dat je snel een beeld krijgt van wat je doet als consultant. Je werkt als stagiair(e) écht mee aan maatschappelijk relevante projecten!” Hier kom je terecht Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen. Dit zijn je directe collega’s Je gaat aan de slag binnen de adviesgroep Energie en leefomgeving in het Expertisecentrum Energie & Strategie (ECES). We zijn een club jonge, enthousiaste en ambitieuze professionals die sterk gemotiveerd zijn om bij te dragen aan de energietransitie. Je collega’s hebben bijvoorbeeld (technische) bestuurskunde gestudeerd, of bedrijfskunde, planologie, energy and environmental sciences, milieustudies, of politicologie. Dit neem je mee Berenschot is een verzameling van persoonlijkheden en achtergronden. We kijken dus vooral of je goed in het team past. We zoeken in elk geval een flinke dosis energie en enthousiasme, gecombineerd met nieuwsgierigheid en de ambitie om jezelf op inhoud en adviesvaardigheden te ontwikkelen. Je werkt graag zelfstandig, maar net zo goed samen. Verder heb je: een sterk analytisch vermogen en uitstekende sociale vaardigheden sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en kun je helder en gestructureerd rapporteren duidelijke interesse in en affiniteit met de energietransitie en verduurzamingsvraagstukken de intrinsieke drive om maatschappelijke impact te maken. Dit bieden we jou Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke werkomgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners, wat ons de vrijheid geeft om te ondernemen en ons in te zetten voor maatschappelijke thema’s. We hebben een informele cultuur, korte communicatielijnen en creëren volop kansen voor persoonlijke en professionele groei. Daarnaast bieden we: een marktconforme stagevergoeding van € 600,– per maand (op fulltimebasis) een laptop flexibele (thuis)werkmogelijkheden persoonlijke begeleiding door een ervaren adviseur een stimulerende en leerzame werkomgeving waarin ruimte is voor eigen inbreng de mogelijkheid om een netwerk op te bouwen binnen Berenschot en onze relaties de mogelijkheid om in te stromen in een Berenschot-traineeship. Om stage te kunnen lopen bij Berenschot, moet je gedurende de gehele stageperiode ingeschreven staan bij een universitaire onderwijsinstelling. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (OptiArray)
description: As a Senior Mechanical Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for the development and engineering realization of the OptiArray system. Your primary objective is to develop robust, structural, easy to manufacture solutions that ensure the array can be easily manufactured, deployed, and operated throughout their intended service life. You translate allocated product and system requirements into engineering solutions that provide structural integrity, mechanical robustness, corrosion resistance, manufacturability, and reliable offshore deployment. You work closely with Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, manufacturing partners, offshore contractors, and specialized suppliers to ensure the array is successfully developed and realized as part of the overall product. Key Responsibilities: Develop and realize robust, manufacturable mechanical and structural solutions for the OptiArray system throughout the product development lifecycle. Translate product and system requirements into mechanical designs suitable for offshore deployment and long-term subsea operation. Design and integrate structural components, interfaces, mounting features, lifting arrangements, and corrosion protection solutions into the overall product. Produce engineering drawings, specifications, calculations, interface documentation, and design records. Perform structural engineering analyses and testing, including lifting loads, fatigue, hydrodynamic behavior, environmental loads, and mechanical robustness. Develop and evaluate prototypes and engineering models to validate structural performance and manufacturability. Drive design improvements focused on manufacturability, assembly, maintainability, reliability, and lifecycle performance. Support product integration, verification, qualification, FAT, and industrialization activities, resolving mechanical and structural issues where required. Perform engineering trade-offs considering structural integrity, weight, cost, manufacturability, corrosion resistance, offshore installation, and lifecycle performance. Work closely with fabrication suppliers, offshore contractors, and technical partners to ensure designs can be successfully manufactured, deployed, and operated. Identify technical risks, investigate root causes, and implement effective design improvements and mitigation measures. Provide technical guidance within the marine structures domain and collaborate across engineering disciplines to support sound technical decisions and successful product delivery. Why Join Us? Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups. Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization. Competitive salary and benefits package. Enjoy regular team activities and company events. Fresh team lunches provided 5 times / week. Qualifications: BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Marine Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Naval Architecture, or related engineering discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience developing offshore, marine, mechanical, or structural systems. Proficiency in working with SolidWorks or equivalent CAD systems to develop and review mechanical designs, assemblies, engineering drawings, and technical documentation. Experience designing marine products, offshore equipment, or subsea mechanical systems. Experience performing structural calculations, load analysis, fatigue assessment, and mechanical interface design. Experience working with fabrication suppliers and manufacturing partners. Experience working within multidisciplinary product development teams. Strong analytical and structured engineering problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Eligible to obtain EU/NATO security clearance. Preferred Experience with corrosion protection, cathodic protection, offshore coatings, or subsea structural design. Hands-on experience with SolidWorks for mechanical design, assembly modelling, and detailed production drawings. Experience taking ownership of a system or significant technical workstream within multidisciplinary engineering projects. Familiarity with systems engineering, product lifecycle management, verification, and configuration management. Screening You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. title: Senior Accountmanager (new business) in Zorg & ICT
description: Je opent nieuwe deuren bij zorgorganisaties en bouwt vanuit vertrouwen aan nieuwe samenwerkingen. Wil jij bijdragen aan dienstverlening in de zorg die er echt toe doet? Krijg jij energie van het leggen van nieuwe contacten en het omzetten van een eerste gesprek in een duurzame samenwerking? En geloof jij oprecht dat goede digitale zorg het verschil maakt voor patiënt en zorgprofessional? Dan willen we jou graag leren kennen. Bij Beter Healthcare draait accountmanagement niet in de eerste plaats om de cijfers. Het draait om mensen, vertrouwen en trots zijn op wat je doet, en om de sterke drive om de zorg én Beter Healthcare stap voor stap vooruit te helpen. Elke dag weer. Wat je gaat doen Als (Senior) Accountmanager ben jij voor nieuwe zorgorganisaties vaak de eerste kennismaking met Beter Healthcare . Je richt je op ziekenhuizen, GGZ- en VVT-organisaties en samenwerkingsverbanden waar we nog niet of nauwelijks werken. Je verkoopt geen product, maar dienstverlening : advies, projectmanagement, interim-inzet en implementatie, samen met de consultants die de inhoud brengen. Je zoekt actief kansen op, weet klant behoeften niet alleen te identificeren maar ook te sturen en laat je niet uit het veld slaan door een nee. title: Sales Enablement (Stage)
description: Lemonway est un établissement de paiement agréé, au cœur de la nouvelle économie européenne. Nous sécurisons les paiements des plateformes de financement participatif, d’économie collaborative, des marketplaces et des e-commerçants, avec un fort engagement contre la fraude et pour la protection des fonds. Réglementée par l’ACPR et bénéficiant du passeport européen dans 29 pays, Lemonway est basée à Paris et Hambourg et rassemble 150 Lemonheroes multiculturels et engagés. Plus de 400 marketplaces nous font confiance. Nous gérons 1,4 million de portefeuilles utilisateurs et avons levé 50 M€ auprès de Breega, SpeedInvest et Toscafund. Rentable depuis quatre ans et en croissance de +25 % en 2025, Lemonway vise à rester parmi les leaders du paiement en Europe grâce à une croissance saine et durable. Secteur : FinTech / Paiements en ligne Localisation : Paris, France (Quartier du Sentier, 2e arrondissement) Télétravail : Jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine (au choix) Le rôle Au sein de notre équipe Alternative Finance Sales , vous contribuerez à renforcer l’efficacité des activités commerciales, de la préparation des campagnes de prospection à la structuration des données et des outils Sales. Ce stage vous permettra de jouer un rôle actif dans le développement commercial de Lemonway, en participant à l’identification de nouvelles opportunités, au mapping de comptes stratégiques et à la préparation de campagnes de prospection ciblées. Vous découvrirez progressivement l’ensemble du cycle de vente, avec l’opportunité de participer aux rendez-vous commerciaux et de contribuer concrètement aux différentes étapes du développement de nos activités. Vos missions Rechercher et cartographier des comptes stratégiques, leurs activités et leurs décideurs. Identifier les interlocuteurs pertinents et enrichir les bases de prospects. Participer à la préparation de campagnes de prospection ciblées. Contribuer à la rédaction de messages et de séquences d’e-mails. Mettre à jour et fiabiliser les données dans Salesforce. Réaliser des recherches de marché et une veille concurrentielle sur les paiements et la FinTech. Identifier des opportunités d’automatisation et contribuer à la création d’outils utilisant l’intelligence artificielle. Préparer des supports commerciaux et participer ponctuellement à des rendez-vous. Ce que vous apprendrez Les fondamentaux du Business Development et de la prospection B2B. Les méthodes de recherche, de mapping et d’analyse de comptes. La construction de campagnes commerciales ciblées. L’utilisation d’un CRM et d’outils de prospection. Les enjeux du marché des paiements et de la finance alternative. Les applications concrètes de l’automatisation et de l’intelligence artificielle dans les activités commerciales. Vous êtes en dernière année d’école de commerce, d’université ou d’une formation en commerce, marketing, finance, stratégie, data ou technologie, et vous recherchez un stage de fin d’études. Nous recherchons avant tout une personne : Curieuse, volontaire et désireuse d’apprendre. Intéressée par la vente B2B, la FinTech, les paiements et les nouvelles technologies. À l’aise avec la recherche d’informations, l’analyse et la structuration de données. Rigoureuse, organisée et attentive à la qualité des informations collectées. Autonome, impliquée et capable de gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle. Dotée d’un bon esprit d’équipe et d’une réelle envie de contribuer. Une appétence pour les outils et les environnements techniques sera un réel atout. Une première expérience avec un CRM, des outils de prospection ou de data enrichment, des solutions d’automatisation, du scraping, des outils no-code, de l’analyse de données ou de l’intelligence artificielle sera particulièrement appréciée. La maîtrise de ces outils n’est toutefois pas indispensable. La maîtrise professionnelle complète du français et de l’anglais , à l’écrit comme à l’oral, est indispensable. La maîtrise de l’ espagnol constitue un atout important. Le processus de recrutement Entretien d’introduction avec Sabina, Talent Acquisition Manager Entretien des compétences techniques avec Maximilien, Senior Account Executive Echange avec Clémentine, Inside Sales Les entretiens permettront notamment d’évaluer votre curiosité, votre capacité d’apprentissage, votre rigueur, vos compétences relationnelles et votre adéquation avec les missions du stage. title: Senior Engineering Manager - Core
description: At Channable , we're building the future of eCommerce automation - and at the core of that vision is a world-class engineering organization. We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to join our Core Group , where you'll play a key role in integrating eCommerce channels. 🚀 About the role: As a Senior Engineering Manager in the Core domain, you will lead an engineering department consisting of 3 team leads (your direct reports) who manage ~11 individual contributors. You’ll be responsible for delivering maximum impact in the Core domain. You will partner up with an experienced Product Lead, with whom you will define and carry out a department vision, strategy, and roadmap. Engaged team leads and individual contributors are top of mind for you. You can learn more about the Core domain and its scope here . 🛠 What you’ll do: Drive the Core roadmap by balancing the overall Channable strategy and the Core's specific opportunities Quantify success by defining and measuring success metrics for the domain as well as team performance Mentor and coach team leads to let them grow and excel at their jobs Drive for high engineering standards by implementing good software development practices and challenging the team to come up with good designs Improve and optimize processes that hamper productivity and can be more lean Build a high-performance culture through fostering accountability, being on top of performance management and focusing on employee engagement You work based on data when you can, and you ensure future decisions take data into account 💡 What we’re looking for: Proven experience as an Engineering Manager leading team leads (preferred) or senior engineers You have demonstrable experience in improving individual and team performance, as well as engagement You have a history of being a software engineer and know how to build high-quality software and the trade-offs that are to be made Outstanding communication skills - you're just as comfortable talking to engineers as you are with stakeholders A mindset focused on pragmatism and growth - you care about setting a high standard for yourself and your team and you continue to reflect to become more productive with minimal technical debt Some practical things we expect from you: You’re available for at least 32 hours per week You're willing to come to our Utrecht office for two days/week You have a valid work permit, and you're located in the Netherlands Note: the official job title for this role within Channable is Engineering Manager. Important note : we understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow. Who are we? Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, and more than +40 nationalities. Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn ! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read. What do we do? Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing. Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/ And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like. 🌟 Why Channable? At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other. What do we offer? Gross annual salary ranging from € 100k-120k, including the 8% holiday allowance and based on a 40-hour work week. Stock Appreciation Rights: You can financially profit from Channable’s success. Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets Saving for old age - we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary. Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth. 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave! Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands! Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources. Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads. Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more! Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. How can you introduce yourself to us? Are you interested? To ensure your application reaches the right team quickly, please submit it in English directly through our careers page by clicking the “Apply” button. Applications submitted via email won’t be considered. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible! Interview steps: If it's a match, we will get in touch with you for an introduction call (around 25 min) Then you are going to have a System Design Interview with our team members (1h) After that, we will schedule a leadership interview (1,5h) Followed by an on-site meeting to get to know your team (1h) Please note that after the interviews and before the offer stage, we’ll conduct reference checks. Important note: In the current AI era, it's tempting to use technology to polish your interview performance. While we value your ambition, please do not use AI assistance during the screening process, so we can get to know the real person behind the resume. Note: Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 for Make-A-Wish. 🚀 About the role:

As a Senior Engineering Manager in the Core domain, you will lead an engineering department consisting of 3 team leads (your direct reports) who manage ~11 individual contributors.

You’ll be responsible for delivering maximum impact in the Core domain. You will partner up with an experienced Product Lead, with whom you will define and carry out a department vision, strategy, and roadmap. Engaged team leads and individual contributors are top of mind for you. You can learn more about the Core domain and its scope here.

🛠 What you’ll do:

  • Drive the Core roadmap by balancing the overall Channable strategy and the Core's specific opportunities

  • Quantify success by defining and measuring success metrics for the domain as well as team performance

  • Mentor and coach team leads to let them grow and excel at their jobs

  • Drive for high engineering standards by implementing good software development practices and challenging the team to come up with good designs

  • Improve and optimize processes that hamper productivity and can be more lean

  • Build a high-performance culture through fostering accountability, being on top of performance management and focusing on employee engagement

  • You work based on data when you can, and you ensure future decisions take data into account


💡 What we’re looking for:

  • Proven experience as an Engineering Manager leading team leads (preferred) or senior engineers

  • You have demonstrable experience in improving individual and team performance, as well as engagement

  • You have a history of being a software engineer and know how to build high-quality software and the trade-offs that are to be made

  • Outstanding communication skills - you're just as comfortable talking to engineers as you are with stakeholders

  • A mindset focused on pragmatism and growth - you care about setting a high standard for yourself and your team and you continue to reflect to become more productive with minimal technical debt

Some practical things we expect from you:

  • You’re available for at least 32 hours per week

  • You're willing to come to our Utrecht office for two days/week

  • You have a valid work permit, and you're located in the Netherlands

Note: the official job title for this role within Channable is Engineering Manager.

Important note: we understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow.

Who are we?

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, and more than +40 nationalities.
Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.

What do we do?

Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing.

Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/

And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like.

🌟 Why Channable?

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.


What do we offer?

  • Gross annual salary ranging from € 100k-120k, including the 8% holiday allowance and based on a 40-hour work week. 

  • Stock Appreciation Rights: You can financially profit from Channable’s success.

  • Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets

  • Saving for old age - we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

  • Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth.

  • 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year

  • Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!

  • Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. 

  • Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. 

  • We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands!

  • Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources.

  • Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads.

  • Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more!

  • Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. 


How can you introduce yourself to us?

Are you interested? To ensure your application reaches the right team quickly, please submit it in English directly through our careers page by clicking the “Apply” button. Applications submitted via email won’t be considered. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible!

Interview steps:

  1. If it's a match, we will get in touch with you for an introduction call (around 25 min)

  2. Then you are going to have a System Design Interview with our team members (1h)

  3. After that, we will schedule a leadership interview (1,5h)

  4. Followed by an on-site meeting to get to know your team (1h)

  5. Please note that after the interviews and before the offer stage, we’ll conduct reference checks.

Important note: In the current AI era, it's tempting to use technology to polish your interview performance. While we value your ambition, please do not use AI assistance during the screening process, so we can get to know the real person behind the resume.

Note: Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 for Make-A-Wish.

At Channable, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration, and we believe in a diverse and inclusive team

title: Productowner
description: Als Product Owner vertaal je visie naar concrete acties en zorg je dat multidisciplinaire (Business en IT) teams maximale waarde leveren voor klant en organisatie. Je ontwikkelt een krachtige productvisie die naadloos aansluit bij onze strategie en zorgt dat deze daadwerkelijkheid gerealiseerd wordt. Wat je over ons moet weten? Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? Je bent het gezicht van de business, bouwt sterke relaties met interne en externe stakeholders en neemt beslissingen met mandaat. Je opereert op het snijvlak van Business en IT en stuurt een Agile Business Team aan dat vraagstukken vertaalt naar waardevolle Epics en Features. Onze strategie is gericht op continue verbetering van Operational Excellence, altijd vanuit klantwaarde, waarbij we processen expliciet koppelen aan de bovenliggende klantreis. Met jouw scherpe prioritering houd je de backlog overzichtelijk, definieer je features en stories en bewaak je de kwaliteit volgens de hoogste standaarden en de Definition of Done. Met jouw scherpe prioriteitenbeheer houd je de backlog overzichtelijk, definieer je features en stories en bewaak je de kwaliteit van opgeleverde producten, altijd volgens de hoogste standaarden en de Definition of Done. Binnen het team breng je focus, stimuleer je samenwerking en zorg je voor energie tijdens demo's en retrospectives. Je brengt focus in het team, stimuleert samenwerking en zorgt voor energie tijdens demo's en retrospectives. Tegelijk bewaak je de functionele (klantwaarde, wetgeving, processen) én technische integriteit van oplossingen. Je stuurt actief op KPI's en bent een aanjager van innovatie en optimalisatie. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat nieuwe vereisten en proposities tijdig en correct worden doorgevoerd in alle relevante systemen, van administratie tot klantcommunicatie, zodat de klantreis over alle kanalen consistent en effectief is ingericht. We werken in een professionele, resultaatgerichte omgeving met veel aandacht voor samenwerking, eigenaarschap en kwaliteit, en schakelen continu tussen business, IT en compliance. #LI-DNI Wat vragen we van jou? Hbo+/wo werk- en denkniveau met analytisch vermogen om complexe processen snel te doorgronden Passie voor de Pensioen Business en affiniteit met domeinkennis (o.a. WTP en keuzebegeleiding is een pré) Ervaring met Agile/SAFe-principes en het werken in multidisciplinaire teams Sterke focus op klanttevredenheid en het vermogen om klantbehoeften te vertalen naar waardevolle oplossingen Organisatorisch talent: je bent aantoonbaar sterk in plannen, structureren en het aanbrengen van prioriteiten Communicatieve kracht: je onderhoudt relaties met stakeholders en weet te overtuigen op basis van argumenten en persoonlijkheid Je beweegt comfortabel op het snijvlak van business en IT en weet verschillende disciplines effectief te verbinden Probleemoplossend vermogen en besluitvaardigheid: je durft keuzes te maken en neemt verantwoordelijkheid Talenkennis: uitstekende beheersing van zowel Nederlands als Engels in woord en geschrift Het is een pré als je werkervaring hebt als Product Owner en in het bezit bent van WFT-certificaten (Basis, Vermogen, Pensioen) We zoeken iemand die niet alleen inhoudelijk sterk is, maar ook persoonlijk leiderschap toont en écht verschil maakt. Jij hebt een duidelijke visie op producten, diensten en onze marktpositie en weet deze overtuigend over te brengen op stakeholders. Je neemt eigenaarschap, voelt je verantwoordelijk en stuurt actief op het behalen van doelen. Besluitvaardigheid is jouw tweede natuur: je durft keuzes te maken en staat achter de gevolgen. Je begrijpt hoe jouw beslissingen de organisatie raken en handelt met organisatiesensitiviteit. En bovenal: je bent een inspirerend voorbeeld voor collega's, toont initiatief en overtuigt met krachtig persoonlijk leiderschap. Wat krijg je van ons? Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag. Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten. In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten. Salaris per maand: Op basis van cao schaal 17 HAY is de range € 5.991,23 tot € 7.988,31 op basis van 36 uur. Enthousiast? Reageer dan snel via de sollicitatie button! title: Mid Market Account Executive - French speaker
description: About Prelude Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever. Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss. Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US. But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead. Why join us Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed. We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build. Our values Care We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship. Bias for Action We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory. Ownership We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results. About the Role As a Mid-Market Account Executive, you'll be responsible for driving growth across one of Prelude’s most strategic segments: mid-sized businesses with high-scale authentication needs. You’ll own the full sales cycle, manage complex evaluations with multiple stakeholders, and partner closely with our technical teams to deliver high-impact solutions. You’ll help shape our mid-market motion, refine our GTM strategy, and play a meaningful role in expanding Prelude’s footprint across Europe and beyond. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who has experience closing mid-market deals and wants to join a fast-growing startup where their impact is immediate and visible. What will you be doing? • Owning and managing the sales cycle for mid-market accounts, from outbound prospecting to contract execution. • Building and maintaining a strong pipeline of high-value prospects across key verticals. • Leading consultative discovery processes to understand customer needs, technical requirements, and decision criteria. • Delivering high-quality demos and value-driven pitches tailored to mid-market use cases. • Navigating multiple stakeholders — from product and engineering to procurement and legal. • Consistently exceeding quota while maintaining healthy win rates and sales velocity. • Delivering on cross-sell, up-sell and renewal opportunities • Sharing insights from customer interactions to help refine product strategy, messaging, and positioning. • Representing Prelude at industry events, conferences, and on-site customer meetings. What are we looking for? • Experience in B2B SaaS sales, including experience closing mid-market deals. • A strong track record of achieving or exceeding quota. • Confidence managing multi-stakeholder, multi-step sales processes • Curiosity - you'll enjoy unpacking how products work under the hood. • The ability to think strategically about accounts, to identify and engage economic buyers. • Someone who will thrive in a fast-paced environment, who enjoys taking initiative. • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills. • Fluency in English and French • Enthusiasm for our product and potential What we offer: • Competitive salary with uncapped commission and generous BSPCEs. • Hybrid working style: 4 days in-office, 1 day remote • High-quality equipment and ergonomic setup. • Annual company offsite (most recent was in the South of France). • A close-knit, high-caliber team that prioritizes product excellence and customer success. • Private healthcare. • Pension scheme. • Swile meal vouchers. Interview Process • A 30-minute call with our talent team to get to know each other. • A 30-minute session with someone in the sales team to go deeper into the role. • On-site interview at our Paris office, including a sales presentation and team meet-and-greet. • A 1-hour meeting with our CEO to explore our strategy and long-term vision. Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before. To win, we focus relentlessly on: Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand. Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout. Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing. The opportunity is massive. Join us to make Conversational Commerce real. About the Team GTM Engineers builds the AI product layer for Gorgias's go-to-market teams: AI agents, internal cockpits, and the automations underneath them, all running on one shared context layer (Cortex). We work across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partnerships. We build and maintain the agents, the business teams own the outputs, and humans review exceptions. About the Role You'll own the AI agents that run Gorgias's GTM workflows, taking them from manual process to reviewed agent. The goal is to optimize as much GTM work as possible without losing quality. A strong fit ships working agents quickly, debugs a broken workflow in Cargo, HubSpot, or another GTM tool without waiting for help, and cares whether the business actually uses what gets built. What You'll Do Navigate between our context layer, our app and service repositories, MCPs, and our automation tools to build and improve end-to-end GTM workflows. Build custom agents and reusable agent skills on our agent stack (Cortex) , and on custom builds when the stack can't do the job. Build and maintain agents for lead and account work: outbound reply handling, audience and call-list building, enrichment, event follow-up, and referral routing. Map the Sales and Marketing workflow backlog, decide Agent vs. Automation vs. Manual for each workflow, and deliver the chosen option with a reviewable output for the business owner. Improve live agents: tune prompts and skills, read conversation and performance data, fix regressions, and document edge cases. Debug broken workflows fast across Cargo, HubSpot, Customer.io , and other GTM tools, and fix the root cause. Connect agents to our systems through APIs and workflows (n8n, Clay, custom code), with credentials managed centrally rather than on personal accounts. Help Sales (BDRs and AEs) and CS adopt agents: learn their daily work, design flows with them, and train them to supervise outputs. Work with the other GTM Engineers (cockpit, data, systems) so agents run on clean CRM data. Who You Are You need to be passionate about AI. Claude Code, Conductor, or another AI coding harness is where you spend most of your time building—not something you only experiment with occasionally. 3+ years in a technical GTM, RevOps, or growth engineering role, with production automations you can point to. Hands-on with LLM applications: prompt design, tool or function calling, and reviewing output quality. Experience building custom agents is a plus. Familiarity with a modern data stack (BigQuery, dbt, Segment, Airbyte, Hightouch) is a plus. Solid SQL and Python or JavaScript, and comfortable working with REST APIs. Working knowledge on outbound or engagement tool (Cargo, Dust, Apollo, Lemlist, Instantly, Customer.io , or similar). Experience with n8n, Clay, or a similar automation tool is a plus. Good business judgment: you know when an agent should draft and when it should act. Ownership: you take a workflow from idea to live agent and flag breakages early. Fluent English. French is a plus for the Paris team. This includes €1500 for learning material (such as books, courses, and individual coaching sessions) directly linked to your job scope, as well as a €500 wellness budget. Take advantage of these resources to grow in your role and prioritize your personal development and wellness. 🥰 Every quarter, we organize an online company-wide summit to discuss where we’re going and strengthen social bonds. Once per year we organize offsite team retreats and company retreats! AI at Gorgias At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones. The real magic happens when we share what we learn. title: Communications, Brand & Events Lead
description: About Orakl Oncology Every cancer patient deserves a treatment that works for them. Today, too many never get one in time: fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs make it through clinical trials, and every failure costs patients precious time. Orakl exists to change those odds. We bridge biological and artificial intelligence by building large cohorts of virtual cancer patients, combining real patients' tumors with their medical histories and deep biological data. By integrating patient-derived tumor models, experimental biology and AI, we help pharmaceutical companies predict how cancer drugs will perform in patients, identify promising treatments and make better decisions earlier in drug development. Founded in 2023 by Fanny Jaulin, PhD, Diane-Laure Pagès, PhD, and Gustave Ronteix, PhD, Orakl is a spin-out of Gustave Roussy, one of Europe's leading cancer centres, building on a decade of research. Backed by international investors, we are scaling our technology and partnerships with pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Discover more at orakl-oncology.com The role We are looking for our first Communications, Brand & Events Lead to build Orakl's external presence from the ground up and establish the company as a leading voice in AI-driven cancer drug development. Your job is to make the world understand what we are building, why it matters and why Orakl is uniquely positioned to lead this transformation. You will shape how Orakl is perceived by the pharmaceutical companies we partner with, the scientists we want to attract, the investors backing us and the broader industry. From defining our corporate narrative and building our reputation to securing media coverage and putting Orakl in the right rooms, you will turn our scientific and commercial progress into visibility, credibility and meaningful relationships. You will own our communications, brand and events strategy, working directly with the founders and closely with our scientific, BD and Product Marketing teams. While Product Marketing focuses on our offerings and their commercial value, you will own Orakl's corporate voice, reputation and external presence. You will also lead internal events and support on internal brand alignment. This is a strategic but highly hands-on role. You will set the direction, build the function and execute much of it yourself, with the autonomy to experiment, make decisions and shape how Orakl grows. You will need to combine the speed and creativity of a startup with the standards of the pharmaceutical industry. Our communications must be distinctive and ambitious, but always grounded in scientific rigour, evidence and credibility. Corporate positioning and narrative. Own Orakl's corporate story, key messages and tone of voice. Build a distinctive narrative around virtual patients and Orakl's role in advancing cancer drug development, ensuring consistency across the company. Brand identity and presence. Own and evolve Orakl's brand identity and visual expression across the website, corporate materials, presentations and digital channels, working with designers and external partners when needed. Content and editorial strategy. Build and manage an editorial calendar that turns Orakl's scientific breakthroughs, company milestones and industry perspectives into compelling content for the right audiences. raw.title: Communications, Brand & Events Lead
raw.description:
About Orakl Oncology

Every cancer patient deserves a treatment that works for them. Today, too many never get one in time: fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs make it through clinical trials, and every failure costs patients precious time.

Orakl exists to change those odds.

We bridge biological and artificial intelligence by building large cohorts of virtual cancer patients, combining real patients' tumors with their medical histories and deep biological data. By integrating patient-derived tumor models, experimental biology and AI, we help pharmaceutical companies predict how cancer drugs will perform in patients, identify promising treatments and make better decisions earlier in drug development.

Founded in 2023 by Fanny Jaulin, PhD, Diane-Laure Pagès, PhD, and Gustave Ronteix, PhD, Orakl is a spin-out of Gustave Roussy, one of Europe's leading cancer centres, building on a decade of research. Backed by international investors, we are scaling our technology and partnerships with pharmaceutical companies worldwide.

Discover more at orakl-oncology.com

The role

We are looking for our first Communications, Brand & Events Lead to build Orakl's external presence from the ground up and establish the company as a leading voice in AI-driven cancer drug development. Your job is to make the world understand what we are building, why it matters and why Orakl is uniquely positioned to lead this transformation.

You will shape how Orakl is perceived by the pharmaceutical companies we partner with, the scientists we want to attract, the investors backing us and the broader industry. From defining our corporate narrative and building our reputation to securing media coverage and putting Orakl in the right rooms, you will turn our scientific and commercial progress into visibility, credibility and meaningful relationships.

You will own our communications, brand and events strategy, working directly with the founders and closely with our scientific, BD and Product Marketing teams. While Product Marketing focuses on our offerings and their commercial value, you will own Orakl's corporate voice, reputation and external presence. You will also lead internal events and support on internal brand alignment.

This is a strategic but highly hands-on role. You will set the direction, build the function and execute much of it yourself, with the autonomy to experiment, make decisions and shape how Orakl grows.

You will need to combine the speed and creativity of a startup with the standards of the pharmaceutical industry. Our communications must be distinctive and ambitious, but always grounded in scientific rigour, evidence and credibility.

What you'll do

Communications and brand: building Orakl's voice

  • Communications strategy. Define and execute Orakl's communications strategy across audiences, channels and markets, setting clear priorities that support the company's commercial, scientific, talent and fundraising ambitions.

  • Corporate positioning and narrative. Own Orakl's corporate story, key messages and tone of voice. Build a distinctive narrative around virtual patients and Orakl's role in advancing cancer drug development, ensuring consistency across the company.

  • Brand identity and presence. Own and evolve Orakl's brand identity and visual expression across the website, corporate materials, presentations and digital channels, working with designers and external partners when needed.

  • Content and editorial strategy. Build and manage an editorial calendar that turns Orakl's scientific breakthroughs, company milestones and industry perspectives into compelling content for the right audiences.

  • Founders' voice and thought leadership. Build the public profiles of Orakl's founders through LinkedIn, articles, op-eds, interviews and relevant scientific and industry channels. Identify the topics and conversations where Orakl can bring a distinctive perspective.

  • Press and media relations. Develop relationships with scientific, pharmaceutical, technology and business media. Identify newsworthy stories, pitch proactively and lead communications around funding, partnerships, scientific advances and company milestones.

  • Speaking opportunities. Build and pitch a targeted pipeline of speaking engagements, panels, podcasts and interviews that position Orakl's founders and scientific leaders as recognised voices in the industry.

  • Reputation and scientific credibility. Ensure all external communications are accurate, evidence-based and consistent with Orakl's scientific standards. Help manage sensitive announcements, complex topics and reputational issues in close collaboration with leadership and scientific teams.

Events: putting Orakl in the right room

  • Events strategy and prioritization. Build Orakl's annual events strategy and calendar, identifying the conferences, industry gatherings and scientific forums that matter most to the business (e.g. JPM, BIO, AACR, BIO-Europe). Define objectives, budgets and expected outcomes for each.

  • Conference presence and execution. Own Orakl's participation in major industry events, from sponsorships, booths and speaking opportunities to registrations, logistics, travel, vendors and on-site execution.

  • Business development activation. Work closely with BD and the founders to identify priority contacts, secure relevant meetings and build targeted engagement programmes around key events. Ensure opportunities are captured and followed up.

  • Orakl-hosted events. Create and run Orakl's own event formats, from intimate scientific dinners and executive roundtables to webinars and partner gatherings, designed to strengthen relationships and generate meaningful conversations.

  • Event content and experience. Own invitations, event branding, booth design, signage and communications before, during and after events, working with Product Marketing on offering-specific and scientific commercial content.

  • Event performance. Evaluate the impact of Orakl's events against their objectives, including strategic relationships developed, meetings secured, commercial opportunities generated and visibility achieved. Use these insights to refine future investments.

Internal communications and culture

  • Internal events. Plan and deliver company off-sites, all-hands gatherings and team celebrations that bring people together and strengthen Orakl's culture.

  • Internal brand alignment. Help teams understand and consistently communicate Orakl's mission, narrative and positioning, ensuring a coherent company voice as the organisation grows.

Building the function

  • Processes and partners. Establish the tools, workflows and external partner network needed to deliver high-quality communications and events efficiently, managing agencies, freelancers and budgets.

  • Measurement and priorities. Define how communications and events success is measured, focusing on quality of visibility, audience relevance, reputation, strategic relationships and contribution to company objectives.

  • Cross-functional collaboration. Work closely with founders, BD, scientific teams and Product Marketing to identify the strongest stories, align priorities and ensure communications supports Orakl's broader ambitions.

What we're looking for

  • Experience in communications, PR, brand or a related role, ideally within life sciences, biotech, healthtech or B2B technology.

  • Strong strategic communications skills, with experience developing corporate narratives, positioning and communications plans that support business objectives.

  • Exceptional writing and storytelling ability, from short-form social content and executive ghostwriting to press releases, long-form editorial, website copy and event communications.

  • Experience in media relations and thought leadership, with a track record of securing relevant earned media, interviews or speaking opportunities and building executive profiles.

  • Ability to communicate complex science, translating technical and scientific concepts into compelling, accurate stories for pharma decision-makers, investors, scientists and broader audiences.

  • Strong editorial judgment, with the ability to recognize what is genuinely newsworthy, identify compelling angles and choose the right audience, channel and moment.

  • Experience in events and conference management, from strategic planning and budgeting to hands-on execution, ideally with an understanding of how events can support commercial relationships.

  • A strong eye for brand and design, with the ability to maintain high creative standards across digital and physical touchpoints.

  • Hands-on and entrepreneurial mindset, equally comfortable setting a strategy, writing a LinkedIn post, pitching a journalist or running an event on-site.

  • Autonomy, creativity and pragmatism, with the confidence to work directly with founders, manage multiple priorities and make things happen in a fast-moving startup.

  • Fluent in English, French is a plus.

  • Work on-site with occasional remote work.

You don't need to come from a traditional life sciences communications background. We value people who combine strong storytelling instincts, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment and the ability to make complex ideas accessible without compromising their accuracy.

  • Shape the voice of an emerging category. Help establish Orakl as a recognised leader in virtual cancer patients and AI-driven drug development.

  • Work at the frontier of AI and cancer research. Bring breakthrough scientific advances to the audiences and organisations that can turn them into real-world impact.

  • Real ownership and direct access to leadership. Work closely with our founders and scientific experts, with significant autonomy, creative freedom and room to grow.

  • Time to recharge. 25 days of paid holiday, plus approximately 9 additional rest days (RTT) per year.

  • Hybrid working. 1–2 days per week occasional work from home.

  4. Reference Call: with one or two former colleagues with whom you worked closely, including a direct manager.

  5. Founder Interview: A final discussion with at least one founder on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.

Updated in October 2026

Target start date: March 1, 2027

Compensation: 70,000 to 85,000 EUR yearly gross, depending on profile

Location: Either in-office in Paris (Grands Boulevards, 75002) or full remote on Paris timezone

 
 

About Upflow

 

Upflow is the Financial Relationship Management (FRM) platform that helps B2B finance teams collect smarter and get paid by their customers faster, with AI agents working alongside the team.

Today, the order-to-cash process is mission critical for businesses, yet it remains fragmented across tools, teams, and workflows. Upflow brings this entire process into one system — four products covering the cycle from invoice to cash (Insights, Collections, Payments, and Cash Application), with AI agents that work alongside the team and a shared intelligence layer underneath.

We serve 500+ companies across 30+ countries, including Vercel, Lattice, and Productboard, and are backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Hedosophia, Hexa, and Lorimer. With teams across the US and Europe, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of finance, payments, and AI.

To learn more about what we do, visit upflow.io.

For a behind-the-scenes look at how we work as a team, head to the Inside Upflow section of our blog at upflow.io/blog/inside-upflow

About the role

You’ll join a small, efficient team who builds high-impact features for our users. You'll work on a wide range of topics, including AI agents, workflow automations, analytics, or payment processing. We invest significantly in AI features, and you'll play a key role in making Upflow the leading agentic software in our field.

We work at a fast pace, averaging 20 deploys to production each day, but with high quality standards, and we value pragmatism, ownership, and a growth mindset.

AI is also transforming how we work, and we're looking for someone eager to use and optimize agents to help us work more efficiently.

You can be based in our Paris office or work remotely.

What you will do

In your day-to-day, you will:

  • Architect and implement complex, high-impact product features from start-to-finish.

  • Collaborate closely with the product manager, the designer, and other engineers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

  • Ship clean, maintainable code to production daily.

  • Participate actively in technical reviews providing and receiving constructive feedback.

  • Troubleshoot and debug complex product issues.

  • Optimize application performance and ensure scalability.

  • Help improve our agentic tools and automations.

Our current stack

  • Frontend: Typescript, React, GraphQL

  • Backend: Typescript, Node.js, Express, Postgres, and Redis

  • Infra: GCP, Terraform

  • Observability: Datadog and Sentry

  • Github, Copilot, Claude Code, CircleCI

Who you are

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering.

  • You have strong proficiency in Typescript, React and SQL.

  • You’re proficient at working with agentic coding assistant such as Claude Code.

  • You have strong skills in architecture, software reliability, and scalability

  • You have a product sensibility and care about UX.

  • You have good teamwork skills and enjoy providing and receiving feedback.

  • You want to work in a startup environment that values excellence, autonomy, and ownership.

  • You are fluent in English with strong communication skills.

  • You are based in Paris, or live in Paris timezone

Why join us

  • International mindset: We have offices in Paris and New York.

  • On-site or full remote: On-site job in Paris (2-3 days in office), or full remote position on Paris timezone (1 monthly visit in our Paris office).

  • Exciting moment: Opportunity to contribute to the Engineering function in the AI era.

  • All-star team: Extremely solid team with deep functional and domain expertise.

  • Learning opportunity: Strong focus on learning and growing through education and professional development.

  • Trusting environment: Hands-off management style. We have a strong culture of ownership and autonomy.

  • Best in class perks: 35 paid days off, meal vouchers, cool offices, top-of-the-range equipment, great healthcare, and competitive salary and equity

  • Offsites: Regular offsites with the team, meetups, and strong connections to the startup ecosystem.

Recruitment Process

1 - Screening call

It’s a discussion with your future manager. We’ll get deeper into your expertise and know-how. We’ll also give you a clearer view of what your day-to-day in that role is like. It’s a good opportunity to see if you foresee yourself working at Upflow.

2 - Take home assignment

It’s a coding exercise that can only be completed successfully with the help of AI. In addition to delivering working software that meets the requirements, you’ll be evaluated on your product and architectural decisions.

3 - Technical interview

In this interview, we’ll review your take-home assignment and discuss how you approach designing scalable systems and making architectural decisions.

4 - Meet the team!

You’ll also meet up with at least two other peers so you can foresee yourself as part of this team.

5 - Founder interview

Meet with Alex (co-founder & CEO). He will tell you everything about Upflow’s vision and values. It’s a privileged moment to ask questions, too.

6 - Alignment and offer

If the team meetings go well on both sides, we’ll invite you to this final step. Getting here means we both see a strong fit and believe Upflow is a place where you can grow and shine over the next few years. We’ll align on how you’ll join us (role scope, start date, package), and if we’re all on the same page, we’ll extend you an offer!

 

*****

Diversity & Inclusion

At Upflow, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage all individuals to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. Research shows that some candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. However, we believe that a variety of experiences and perspectives can bring value beyond the listed qualifications. If you’re excited about what we do and feel you could contribute, we want to hear from you.

title: City Launcher, Groningen
description: Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour. We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural. Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house - hardware and software, we're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week. Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company . You might enjoy our YouTube Channel , Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage , or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like . About the role Over the last few years, Monumental has gone from developing a product that works and delivering our first pilots to building at scale - a fleet of 150+ robots that have laid bricks for 90+ homes, a school, a community centre, a hotel, and 150+ m of canal walls. We're taking on more construction projects - "deployments" - every month, with more robots, more people, and now in new markets as we scale from the Netherlands into the UK and US. As Hub Lead, you’ll stand up our first hub outside HQ, in the north of the Netherlands. You’ll start by running our largest deployment to date, then build the team and operations around it as the project pipeline ramps up behind you. We're hiring versatile operators who want to run a deployment as if it were their own business. Behind every one of these projects is a Deployment Manager who owns it end to end. In practice this is five jobs in one: site foreman, operations manager, account executive, analyst, and project manager. You make the build plan, deploy yourself with your team on site as a subcontractor, manage the contractor relationship, and take responsibility for delivering quality walls, finished on time - in construction, one of the most chaotic industries there is. Your goal will be to run multiple deployments in parallel, overseeing complex and high stakes projects. One day you're up at dawn, travelling to site, cutting bricks, running the schedule, working with the general contractor and watching your build plan go up brick by brick. The next you'll be at our facility analysing your deployment's P&L and building the systems that improve your margin on the next deployment. You’ll own delivery and translating friction you observe on-site to our R&D team. This is hard, on-site operations, and some of the most rewarding work you'll find. Robots break, weather turns, the contractor changes the plan, and it's on you to keep the build moving. You'll have an extraordinary amount of autonomy. It's an excellent fit if you've founded a company before, or if you're looking for an entrepreneurial role where you can make outsized impact. What you’ll do Plan the logistics of a deployment: decide how many and which robots and humans to send, coordinate with other subcontractors, and make both a day-to-day operational plan while also thinking about the bigger picture and how your decisions impact our unit economics. Spend time on the construction site, overseeing, managing, and motivating the team; liaising with the general contractors and other stakeholders; and generally representing the company and selling our story. You’re comfortable speaking with the guys building scaffolds, the CEOs of the biggest general contractors, and our engineers, all on the same day. Build the operational systems that make each deployment run better than the last - spotting inefficiencies, fixing processes, improving margin Work with our existing customer base and drive growth of new construction projects and, in the future, adjacent product lines beyond bricklaying. Own the P&L of your deployment and propose ways to continuously improve our unit economics. Support hiring and interviewing additional robot and deployment operators. What we’re looking for Minimum of 3 years of experience in management as a startup founder, GM, in operations, strategy, business development or a similar area. Given the local nature of the construction industry, this role requires you to be a native Dutch speaker. You generally need to be an excellent communicator and be comfortable speaking with a broad range of personas. You don’t mind getting your hands (literally) dirty to get the job done. A strong bias-to-action and getting-shit-done mentality with the required tenacity and speed. The emphasis of this role is execution, not analysis. You’re comfortable in a high-stress environment. Things constantly go wrong at construction sites, the stakes are high, and we’re introducing new technology with novel failure modes. Raw intellectual horsepower and eagerness to learn. We expect this role to have a steep learning curve whatever your background, and this role might in practice feel like a completely new job every 3-6 months. You’ll learn a lot about construction, robotics, and being part of a high-growth, hard-tech company. Experience and ability to manage, lead, and motivate a (small) team. Strong operational and analytical skills. You can build a spreadsheet with a clear operational plan, or present a P&L and model various scenarios and drivers. You’re a strong project manager. Why Monumental? Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. Here, your work has the potential to impact not just the company but the future of how we build. If you're driven by innovation, eager to tackle complex challenges, and ready to make a tangible difference, we want to hear from you. For open applications (where you don’t see an exact role match), please reach out to us at: ----- - share with us the most interesting or challenging project you’ve worked on, why you want to join and your CV or portfolio. Unfortunately we do not currently support internships. If you don’t meet all the qualifications here but are excited about Monumental and feel you’d still be able to help us solve difficult problems, do get in touch. We welcome generalists who focus on outcomes and are eager to learn on the job. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
